==Objectives==
Slay a Dreadlord within The Tainted Scar, and bring his Heart to Daio the Decrepit.
*[[Dreadlord Heart]]

==Description==
Heh.. He has a question, does he?

<The old, withered man lets out a crooked laugh, a wiry smirk resting upon his aged features.>

I haven't spoken to Mahar Ba in a long, long time, if he wants information, than I need something done, favor or no favor!

If you want to know the truth, than I require something from you.

Within the Tainted Scar lies a secretive race of demon, the Dreadlord, I have been meaning to practice all sorts of magic and I need a singular heart. Bring me a Dreadlord Heart, and I shall tell you what I know.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*6450 XP
*+300 [[reputation]] with [[Dalaran (faction)|Dalaran]]

==Progress==
Yes yes yes, do you have my heart?

==Completion==
A Dreadlord Heart, oh how I desired, and needed one. You've done me a real favor, I shall answer your question.
